blocks.text: Store interior design and custom furniture, 50 m²

DUMSKAYA DESIGN (Bratislava, Slovakia) developed an interior design project for a 50 m² store and also designed and manufactured custom furniture for the retail space. In developing the interior, particular attention was paid to the functional organization of a small floor area, convenience for customers and staff, product presentation, and creating a cohesive visual identity for the store. The layout solutions make efficient use of the available space and ensure comfortable customer flow. Custom retail furniture was designed for the project and integrated into the overall interior concept. Individual design makes it possible to account for the room dimensions, how products are displayed and stored, functional requirements, and the company’s visual style. This page features photorealistic 3D visualizations of the design project, showing the layout, the design of the retail space, and the furniture solutions developed for it. DUMSKAYA DESIGN offers interior design for stores, boutiques, showrooms, and other commercial spaces, as well as custom furniture design and manufacturing in Bratislava and Vienna. We create bespoke interior solutions for retail and commercial spaces, tailored to the specifics of the business and the premises.
